requirements.text: Implement flatten_tree(value) yielding (path_tuple, leaf_value) pairs for leaves in nested dictionaries and lists.
Traverse dictionary insertion order and list index order, with an empty dictionary or list treated as a leaf.
Detect a container cycle on the current ancestry and raise ValueError instead of recursing forever.

regressions.text: Shared but acyclic subcontainers may appear at multiple paths, and input containers must not be modified.
